verdict.rationale: Gusto documents next-day, 2-day and standard 4-day payroll processing, with expedited payroll requiring submission only one or two business days before the check date, and it handles the bank transfers. A community user confirms using 2-day payroll but reports it was capped at roughly $60k, requiring repeated support exceptions; that is a limitation, not a contradiction. Missing for 10: expedited speed is limited to 'qualifying companies' with no stated criteria; no explicit first-party statement that employees (not just contractors) receive direct deposit; the docs describe the Embedded Payroll API rather than the founder-facing app; and funding limits on fast payroll are undocumented.
